Tests the 3-tool MCP server functionality using the MCP client, bypassing service layer issues.

# Purpose
This code is a Python script designed to test the functionality of a 3-tool MCP (Multi-Component Platform) server using an MCP client. It uses asynchronous programming with the `asyncio` library to perform a series of tests that verify the server's capabilities. The script connects to the MCP server and executes various operations such as listing tools, retrieving a code map, reading driver documentation, listing directory contents, and handling prompts. Each test checks for errors and prints the results to the console, providing feedback on the server's responses. The script is intended to be run as a standalone program, as indicated by the `if __name__ == "__main__":` block, which executes the [`test_mcp_server_via_client`](<#test_mcp_server_via_client>) function using `asyncio.run()`.
